map.SLEDAI-2K（系统性红斑狼疮疾病活动度指数），24项加权评分，评估SLE近: SLEDAI-2K (Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Disease Activity Index), 24 weighted items, assesses SLE disease activity over the past 10 days
map.勾选近10天内存在/新发或加重的项目，系统按权重自动计算SLEDAI-2K总分: Check items present/new/worsened within the past 10 days; the system auto-calculates the SLEDAI-2K total by weight
map.逐项勾选：关节炎2+皮疹2+蛋白尿4+补体降2+dsDNA升2 = 12；器官分: Item by item: arthritis 2 + rash 2 + proteinuria 4 + low complement 2 + rising dsDNA 2 = 12; organ items: renal 4 / skin 2 / immune 4, moderate-severe lupus activity.
map.无项勾选 → 0，缓解期维持治疗。: No items checked → 0, maintenance therapy in remission.
map.本页为评分式（rater），sledai 为量表展示式，均按 SLEDAI-2K: This page is the rating form (rater), sledai is the scale display form; both use SLEDAI-2K weights.
map.神经精神 8 分、肾/血管炎 6 分最重，直接影响活动分级与治疗强度。: Neuropsychiatric 8, renal/vasculitis 6 are heaviest, directly affecting activity grading and treatment intensity.
map.本工具基于 SLEDAI-2K（系统性红斑狼疮疾病活动度指数2000版），纯前端: This tool is based on SLEDAI-2K (Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Disease Activity Index 2000), runs entirely in-browser, data is not uploaded to any server

map.SLEDAI-2K≥10分提示活动性SLE，通常需要加强免疫抑制治疗: SLEDAI-2K ≥10 suggests active SLE, usually requiring intensified immunosuppression
